description: Overlapping stack of avatars with a "+N" overflow — a team, the people on a thread. Presentational; the caller supplies the list. The overflow disc carries the hidden count so it is not silent to a screen reader.

props.name: max
props.description: Show at most this many, then a "+N" overflow disc. Default 4.

props.name: size
props.description: The group's role on the screen: `sm` inside a row or a meta line, `lg` when the team is what the block is about. No middle position.
